subject: Archive gating & temporary immutable-log exception for Medibridge onboarding
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@medibridge.health>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@medibridge.health, privacy@regcompliance.io
Date: Wed, 10 Jan 2029 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Archive gating ask + temporary log immutability window

Hi Laura,

Quick context: Medibridge is moving a tranche of PHI-adjacent records onto Redwood next month. Our privacy team is asking for a short-term carveout that keeps a specific set of write-audit logs and backups immutable for 45 days beyond the standard retention window while we complete an incoming audit and cross-border transfer checks.

Questions:
- Can Redwood hold an immutable snapshot (read-only) of the last 90 days of write-audit logs and one offsite backup for 45 additional days after the planned purge date?
- If yes, what is the cost and who signs the amendment?

We can provide a scoped list of log prefixes and the S3 object IDs if that helps. Procurement is copied to loop vendor contracting.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Ruiz
Head of IT Security, Medibridge Health

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@medibridge.health>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, procurement@medibridge.health
Date: Wed, 10 Jan 2029 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Archive gating ask + temporary log immutability window

Marta — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Markus (legal/lead) and Karthik (privacy ops) to confirm what we can commit to without creating a permanent carveout. High level:

- We can create an "immutable hold" on specific backup snapshots and log prefixes for a bounded window, with an operator-controlled release.
- That hold is operationally treated as an escrowed snapshot; it adds overhead and will appear as an add-on on the monthly invoice.
- We need a short amendment to the DPA that: (1) lists the retained object keys/prefixes, (2) limits the window (e.g., 45 days), (3) grants Medibridge access to a read-only view for inspection, and (4) sets a deletion trigger and audit trail once the window expires.

Action items for us:
- Markus: draft the minimal DPA amendment and provide procurement language.
- Karthik: advise on evidence we need (SOC2 artifact, retention control-plane screenshots) to support the audit.
- Laura (me): scope the operational runbook and estimate cost.

I will start an internal runbook draft and attach the proposed cost model by EOD Friday.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Enterprise Solutions (Redwood Inference)

From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@medibridge.health>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, procurement@medibridge.health
Date: Thu, 11 Jan 2029 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Archive gating ask + temporary log immutability window

Marta / Laura — I reviewed the request with legal. We can do a timeboxed amendment to the DPA. Key legal guardrails:

- Amendment will expressly state this is a temporary escrow/hold and not a change to our baseline retention policy.
- We will require the customer to specify object keys/prefixes and provide a signed attestation that the hold is required for a lawful audit/investigation.
- Redaction of unnecessary fields: if logs contain unrelated PII, we will collaborate on redaction guidance; full log replication is not permitted without an additional data processing agreement appendix.

I'll circulate a one-page amendment (for signature) by tomorrow. Draft will include a limited indemnity carveout and a capped operational fee.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Chief Legal Officer, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@medibridge.health>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, privacy@regcompliance.io
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2029 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Archive gating ask + temporary log immutability window

Marta — operational notes from privacy/controls:

- Evidence we will request from Medibridge before we enable the hold: SOC2 report for the last 12 months (redacted where needed), the audit charter that requires the hold, and a list of the exact log prefixes/object IDs.
- For the sake of minimizing scope, please limit the request to the smallest possible prefix set and only the backup snapshot necessary for the audit.
- Temporary hold workflow:
  1) Customer submits request form + attestation.
  2) Redwoods security team performs a manual review (48 hours SLA).
  3) If approved, ops creates an immutable copy with a TTL marker of X days (45).
  4) Customer gets read-only access for inspection via a signed URL or console view; no download unless covered by further legal agreement.

Costs: estimated $1,200 flat setup + $0.10/GB/day for retained snapshot storage over the hold window (finalized once object sizes are provided).

I'm attaching the technical runbook and a proposed config for the TTL marker.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Privacy Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_escrow_plan_v2.pdf

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@medibridge.health>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, procurement@medibridge.health, privacy@regcompliance.io
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2029 16:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Archive gating ask + temporary log immutability window

Marta — next steps and timeline: 

- Medibridge: please send (1) signed attestation, (2) list of object keys/prefixes, and (3) SOC2 redacted report to privacy@redwood.ai by EOD Monday (1/22).
- Markus: please share the DPA amendment draft (I expect a one-pager).
- Karthik & Ops (Olga): prepare the runbook and a cost estimate. I recommend we present a single purchase order line ("Temporary escrowed snapshot — 45 days") to keep procurement clean.

I attached the proposed DPA amendment draft and a runbook excerpt for your review. Cost estimate (preliminary): setup $1,200 + $0.10/GB/day. Final invoice will reflect actual retained GBs.

If Medibridge confirms, we can schedule the manual review week of 1/29 and enable the hold within 48 hours of approval.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed-dpa-amendment.docx; medibridge-retention-evidence.zip (attachment-stub)
